page_title: SEV 1-0 CEL | Sevilla v Celta Vigo 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' Dario Benavides (Sevilla) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+4' The yellow card is received by Marcao (Sevilla).
90+3' Alvaro Fernandez (Sevilla) is given a yellow card.
90+3' Although Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) is just on the bench, Jesus Manzano has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+3' Loic Bade (Sevilla) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Substitution. Nemanja Gudelj walks off the pitch and Marcao (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' The attendance is 37295.
89' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
87' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
86' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Gonzalo Montiel is replaced by Dario Benavides (Sevilla).

85' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
83' Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Mihailo Ristic leaves the pitch to be replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
78' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) picks up an injury.
75' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) coming on for Pablo Duran.
73' Here is a change. Fran Beltran is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
73' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Sevilla.
71' The game has come to an end for Jesus Navas. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla).
70' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manuel Bueno Sebastian.
68' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) replacing Williot Swedberg.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Alvarez departs the field of play to be replaced by Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
65' 1 - 0 Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
64' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
64' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.

61' A sweet pass inside the box gives Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
60' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
58' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
58' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
56' A cross into the box from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is cleared.

54' Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
54' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
51' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
47' Wonderful movement by Sevilla. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta makes a half-time substitution. Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) comes on in place of Kelechi Iheanacho.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' The game has begun to heat up. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
43' Kike Salas (Sevilla) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Manzano signals.
41' Sevilla exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.

39' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
38' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
36' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
32' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

31' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sevilla are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
29' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) serves up a nice cross, but Alvaro Fernandez punches the ball away.
29' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tries to find Williot Swedberg with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
26' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
25' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.

23' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the left side of the goal, but Alvaro Fernandez pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
21' Sevilla are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
18' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the right post!
18' Celta Vigo have a corner.
17' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Fernandez intercepts the ball. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

11' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
10' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
8' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
6' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
4' A long ball forward to Kelechi Iheanacho (Sevilla) is intercepted.
3' Sevilla are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
1' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The match has just started.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jesus Manzano.
